lines.text: This is Rosa. She runs a bakery, and a customer owes her twenty-eight hundred dollars.
But Rosa owes the mill three thousand. The mill owes the trucking company. And the trucking company? It owes Rosa.
Everyone is owed. Nobody can pay. So everyone waits.
Fifty-six percent of American small businesses are owed money right now. About seventeen and a half thousand dollars each.
But debts that run in a circle can simply cancel. No money has to move.
On our Main Street, twenty-eight thousand dollars of invoices settled with just twenty-two hundred dollars of PayPal payments.
Untangle is an AI clearing house for small-business debt, built on PayPal.
Our engine finds the loops of debt that no single business can see, and cancels them without moving a dollar.
It scales. Ten thousand businesses and sixty thousand invoices clear in about a second, right in the browser.
Every debt here is a real PayPal sandbox invoice. Twenty-five invoices, twenty-eight thousand one hundred dollars owed, in one AG Grid ledger.
One click starts a clearing cycle. AI agents read each business's PayPal invoices, and a watchdog checks every one against PayPal.
Each set-off is recorded on the PayPal invoice itself, as an external payment. Twenty-two of them, on real invoices.
Then each business's treasurer agent checks the deal against its owner's signed policy, and signs.
The owner signs the statement. Everything left is settled with just three PayPal payments.
Twenty-eight thousand dollars of debt, settled. Only twenty-two hundred dollars moved. Twelve point eight times leverage.
Untangle. Clear the loop. Pay only the rest.
